== Title ==
<span lang="ja">こんなはずじゃあ…</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">任意の男性キャラクターに配備する。場に出ている女性キャラクターを1人、目標とする。目標は戦闘力－2。目標と同じ場所にいることになったら、ウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「なんで、そんな風に思えるのかしら？ どうやら女性についてあまり御存じないようね」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — This Is Just Wrong.

'''Lore''' — “How could you think that? You apparently don’t know much about women.”

'''Game text''' — Deploy on any male character. Target one female character in play. The target is power −2. Cancel the Utinni Effect when it is at the same place as the target.

The original English says to cancel the Effect when it is present with the target. The Japanese uses the wording 同じ場所 (same place). Both print a power penalty of 2.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-thisisjustwrong.gif|Original English face]], [[This Is Just Wrong]].</ref>
